title: Religious References in Lindsay Clancy Trial Anger Judge and Defense
summary: The religious reference by a prosecution witness on Monday incensed the presiding judge, who sternly instructed jurors to disregard it. Lindsay Clancy’s lawyer asked for a mistrial.
